summary: Retry one concurrent parser PermissionError in isolation, reject occupied live target ports before credential handling, and block project answers when a selected document failed parsing.
decision_refs: The current three-file run processed both drawing PDFs but the 401-page specification failed with PermissionError while all three parser processes ran together
The same saved specification completed all 401 pages both serially and with four page workers in isolated offline reproductions
The active service remained Mock while the DeepSeek setup page was still listening and the live target port was occupied
The user explicitly requested repair and a new DeepSeek analysis
approval_evidence: User explicitly requested repair and authorized DeepSeek analysis of the already uploaded test files.
known_limitations: Only PermissionError receives the isolated parser retry; timeouts, corrupt inputs, unsupported formats and model failures retain their existing explicit recovery paths.
The retry is local parsing only and never retries or duplicates a paid model call.
A live analysis still requires a valid locally entered or Windows-DPAPI-saved DeepSeek credential and sufficient project budget.
